svg.title: The total phase allowance is about 0.00573 degrees. This is a narrow, precisely declared operating region near the ideal apparatus, not an operating certificate for the principal noisy benchmark η = .8, v = .9 (whose separate finite-horizon comparison is handled in the continuous-reader paper), nor for the specified larger asymmetric box a = .9, b = .8, η0 = .8. The uncertainty set includes the ideal apparatus. Hence every robust randomized-nonadaptive protocol still has worst error at least the universal ideal lower bound 1/32 at four copies. A stronger pointwise statement is also available: for any fixed nuisance tuple, each nonnull unsharp equatorial measurement is an ideal equatorial projector at its effective Bloch direction followed by an independent sign flip, together with the sign-blind erasure. A nonadaptive schedule remains nonadaptive under this simulation. Thus adding these detector imperfections cannot improve the full-menu nonadaptive optimum. This is a statistical simulation, not an identification of inaccessible environments. An explicit five-copy nonadaptive upper construction repeats the bisector and takes fair-tie majority.
